message.name: ReturnStandingOrderV06
message.definition: Scope|The ReturnStandingOrder message is sent by a transaction administrator to a member.|It is used to provide information on the details of one or more standing orders, based on specific request and return criteria.|in response to a request a on information on standing and predefined orders.|Usage|The ReturnStandingOrder message lists the standing order based on the following possible return criteria: |- Generic standing order details,|- Details of a specific predefined or standing liquidity transfer orders,|- Details on the set to which the standing order belongs to,|- List of all predefined and standing liquidity transfer standing orders and/or per set,|- Total amount of predefined and standing liquidity transfer orders defined in the system.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.
